register.labelZh: GRIND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: grind on 可以描述談判、爭論、會議和其他長時間持續的困難情況。；grind somebody down 可以表示反覆的批評、不公平對待或壓力逐漸消磨一個人。；grind something down 適合用來描述處理粗糙邊緣、金屬零件和其他堅硬物件。；grind something out 可以描述作家、樂隊、工廠或機構不斷製作相似的作品或產品。
register.summaryEn: Grind on can describe talks, arguments, meetings and other difficult situations that continue for a long time. Grind somebody down shows that repeated criticism, unfair treatment or pressure slowly weakens a person. Grind something down is useful when describing work on rough edges, metal parts and other hard objects. Grind something out can describe a writer, band, factory or organisation repeatedly producing similar work.
